mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high but slowing retail sales growth (RSAFS) signals an economic peak, leading to reduced corporate profit growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion by RSAFS growth, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity and corporate capacity utilization, which supports earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and fall in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a sectoral imbalance in the economy, where manufacturing strength is offset by housing weakness, reducing overall economic confidence and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises and HOUST falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market peak regime, high but declining housing starts (HOUST) signals an economic slowdown in the housing sector, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as housing market peak by HOUST decline, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
